Trajectory & Differentiation Lineage Dynamics

Source: R/06_metrics_trajectory.R
metrics_trajectory.Rd

Trajectory comparison metrics including geodesic pseudotime correlation, pseudotime distribution distance, and lineage tree branch height discrepancy. Supports automated trajectory and lineage tree inference directly from scRNA-seq counts.

Developed by Kabilan S, Dr Dwijesh Chandra Mishra, Dr Shashi Bhushan Lal, Dr Sudhir Srivastava, Dr Krishna Kumar Chaturvedi.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
